evals.name: github-in-hf-metadata-merge-tags
evals.prompt: Enrich the paper arxiv 2606.25605 ("Constraint Tax in Open-Weight LLMs") in the paperswithcode database — it's missing its code repository and could use better task/method tags.
evals.expected_output: Saves official GitHub repo https://github.com/Fzsama/Constrain-Tax-26-06 (found via HF API). No project page (none exists). Adds sensible tags (e.g. tool-use / function-calling / agents) while PRESERVING existing tasks (language-modeling) and methods (function-calling, large-language-model-llm). Reports the paper URL.

assertions.text: Official GitHub repo github.com/Fzsama/Constrain-Tax-26-06 is linked to the paper as is_official=true
No false/incorrect GitHub repo (e.g. an unrelated cited repo) was linked
Pre-existing tags are preserved: language-modeling task and methods function-calling + large-language-model-llm still present
Final tag set is sensible for a tool-calling/structured-output LLM paper (no obviously irrelevant tags added)

evals.name: project-page-only-no-github-authentic-negative
evals.prompt: Can you find the GitHub repo and project page for arxiv 2606.27377 and make sure it's tagged correctly on paperswithcode?
evals.expected_output: Saves the project page https://danceopd.github.io/ (from HF API) as official. Correctly finds NO GitHub repo (project page HTML has none) and does NOT hallucinate one. Preserves/curates tags (existing: image-generation; methods classifier-free-guidance, online-rl, on-policy-distillation). Reports project page saved, no github found.

assertions.text: Project page https://danceopd.github.io/ is linked to the paper as official
No GitHub repository was invented/linked (authentic negative — none exists)
Existing tags are preserved (not clobbered to empty)
Report mentions that no GitHub repo was found and that the project-page HTML was checked

evals.name: no-tasks-and-false-positive-method
evals.prompt: This paper https://paperswithcode.co/paper/2606.26092 (TryOnCrafter) has no task tags and looks mis-tagged. Please enrich it.
evals.expected_output: Adds appropriate task tag(s) for video virtual try-on / video generation (the paper currently has zero tasks). Saves project page https://sunhao242.github.io/TryOnCrafter_web.github.io/. Recognizes that the existing method tag 'hallucination' is a false positive for a video try-on paper and removes it (with justification) while keeping diffusion-transformer-dit. Reports actions.

assertions.text: At least one relevant task tag was added (paper had zero tasks; should now have a video/try-on/generation task)
Project page https://sunhao242.github.io/TryOnCrafter_web.github.io/ is linked as official
The false-positive method tag 'hallucination' is removed OR explicitly flagged as wrong in the report
The legitimate existing method diffusion-transformer-dit is preserved
No invented GitHub repo (none exists for this paper)
